description: A scientific, authoritative yet accessible design for an Air Quality Intelligence Platform. Avoids generic SaaS templates by utilizing structural monochrome foundations with precise, data-driven AQI accent colors. Bridges the gap between an immersive marketing landing page (3D R3F Globe) and a dense, functional analytical dashboard.

headings.usage: Use font-light for subheadings, font-black for massive data points and hero headings. Tracking-tight is mandatory for H1/H2.

dataMono.usage: Used strictly for AQI numbers, pollutant metrics (µg/m³), and coordinates.

hero.left: col-span-1 md:col-span-5 flex flex-col justify-center p-8 md:p-16 z-10
hero.right: col-span-1 md:col-span-7 relative h-[60vh] md:h-screen w-full
hero.rules: Never center the hero content. Use massive typography on the left. The right side is a full-bleed R3F canvas.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Grid Borders (Technical)' look for the dashboard. Cards should have 1px borders, flat backgrounds, no heavy drop shadows. Rely on spacing (p-6, p-8) and border collapse styling to create a clinical, precise feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For the sticky navbar and floating AI chat modal, use heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) with an inner 1px border. Do not use fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.hoverStates: Buttons and interactive cards should have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and an explicit text color change to ensure contrast.

components_strategy.hero: Pure HTML/Tailwind structure. No Shadcn cards here. Implement responsive absolute positioning for the 3D canvas.
components_strategy.dashboard: Use Shadcn UI for structured widgets (Cards, Select, Dialogs for pollutant details). Customize Shadcn default radii to rounded-xl.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Strip out default grid lines, use single-color stroke with a subtle opacity gradient fill below the line.
components_strategy.map: Leaflet. Use React-Leaflet. Map tiles must match the theme (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter for dark mode).
components_strategy.ai_assistant: Floating chat interface using Shadcn Sheet or Dialog. Must have a glowing indicator reflecting the current AQI color.

globe.implementation: Use a Sphere geometry. Apply a base texture (earth map). In dark mode, use an emissive map for city lights. Overlay glowing markers (points) colored by AQI severity. Wrap in a <Suspense> boundary. Ensure lighting (DirectionalLight, AmbientLight) makes the globe crisp.

fresh_air.usage: Use in the 'Outdoor Activity Guidance' section or 'Good AQI' state background.

smog_city.usage: Use in the 'Health Tips' or 'High Risk' alert modals as a contextual header.

mask_info.usage: Hero image for the 'Masks Info & Educational' page.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sharp, technical look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on colored AQI badges (especially Yellow/Moderate) meets 4.5:1 ratio. If yellow is too bright, use black text on the yellow badge.
accessibility.motion: Wrap the R3F globe's autoRotate and any CSS transitions in a prefers-reduced-motion media query check if possible, or provide a pause button.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (Search, Use My Location, Login, Chart toggles) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='location-search-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: yarn add @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three recharts react-leaflet leaflet
Install Google Fonts (Chivo, Outfit, JetBrains Mono) via index.css imports.
Do not center-align text globally. Left-align data for a scientific feel.
Do not use generic AI emojis.
Ensure dark mode is the default state.
Build a robust Layout component that includes a sticky glassmorphism Navbar and a Footer.
For the 3D globe, create a dedicated component. If a texture fails to load, use a solid color standard material with a wireframe fallback.
The AQI color scale MUST precisely follow the hex codes defined in the guidelines.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6 to p-12) than feels comfortable.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Lucide.
Prioritize existing Shadcn components, customize their styles via Tailwind to fit the theme.
